content: htmx 1.x->2.x breaking changes: IE dropped; all extensions moved out of core to separate packages; hx-sse/hx-ws removed; hx-vars removed (use hx-vals js:); hx-on removed in favour of hx-on:<event>; DELETE now uses URL params not form body (htmx.config.methodsThatUseUrlParams); htmx.config.selfRequestsOnly now defaults true; scrollBehavior default 'smooth'->'auto'; selectAndSwap() -> swap(); makeFragment() always returns DocumentFragment. Latest release 2.0.10 (2026-04-21). Pin >= 2.0.2: 'file upload is now fixed' in 2.0.2, which also fixed indicators sticking after a full-page redirect and disabled elements not being re-enabled before history snapshot. 2.0.7 added reportValidity() behind a config flag and made the indicator style visibility:hidden for screen readers.
